name: shape-first-design
description: Skills for finding a project's shape, mapping it as invariants, and developing it by that map

plugins.name: shape-first-design
plugins.description: Map a project, then develop it by the map: an interview that writes its intent, primitives, capabilities and interfaces under docs/ as statements that must always hold, and a development skill that keeps the code in the primitives' shape and checks it keeps the invariants.
